decision: Emit calibrated topology identity at the qrexec campaign source and consume it without runner-side post-processing.
problem: The qualification runner previously injected topologyId and calibrationEvidenceDigest into campaign_start after the harness completed. That proved runner configuration, but not that raw execution evidence originated with the calibrated selection identity.

independent_reviews.reason: The campaign harness must emit topologyId and calibrationEvidenceDigest in campaign_start itself; otherwise raw evidence can be detached from the calibration selection that justified the worker topology.
rejected: runner-side JSONL post-processing because it can strengthen evidence after execution
re-running calibration during qualification because it changes the measured evidence set and adds unnecessary work

independent_reviews.preferred: fail-closed environment binding at harness startup
independent_reviews.reason: Missing topology or malformed calibration digest now prevents the campaign from starting. Collector validation preserves the fields and qualification rejects legacy/mixed evidence.
rejected: optional source fields because legacy evidence could still enter the qualification path
external evidence database because it adds credentials, service lifecycle, and a larger attack surface

independent_reviews.reason: Adds zero qrexec round trips, negligible CPU/RAM, no new daemon/database, and no MissionQueue/coordinator mutation changes.
rejected: extra remote attestation call because existing Ed25519 response attestation already covers coordinator-origin responses
new persistence layer because calibration identity is execution provenance, not worker state

positive: qualification runner passes topology/digest to every harness process
all lease/recovery runs share the exact calibrated identity
negative: wrong or mixed digest across runs is rejected
legacy harness evidence without native binding is rejected

failures_and_lessons: Post-processing can make evidence look stronger than what the execution source actually emitted.
Calibration identity belongs at campaign_start, before any qrexec execution evidence is interpreted.
Qualification should validate source evidence, not repair it.
release_gate: Keep LAB READY until Node/Swift QA execute green on the same head and real Qube-to-Qube qualification returns qualification.ready=true.
